sloka: स सम्प्राप्य चिरात् सञ्ज्ञामृषभो वानरर्षभः।अबिदुद्राव वेगेन गदां तस्य महात्मनः ।। ६.७०.५८ ।।
transliteration: sa samprāpya cirāt sañjñāmṛṣabho vānararṣabhaḥ।abidudrāva vegena gadāṁ tasya mahātmanaḥ ।। 6.70.58 ।।

translations.english: Regaining consciousness after a long time the monkey chief, Rshaba, was angry, his lips quivering as he was, ran to Mahaparsva.
